# Set of hosts a short link may point to

> A set of two host names, built once when [`ShareLinkService`](link-click-analytics.md) starts, that a short link's destination must match.

_Part of [Check that a destination is a marketplace page](destination-validation.md)_

When [`ShareLinkService`](link-click-analytics.md) is created, it reads the `front_host` setting (the marketplace's front-end address). It takes the host part of that address and stores it in `allowedHosts`, a [`Set`](../../../../packages/payments/internal/consumer/consumer.go#L210). It also adds the same host with `www.` in front. So a front end at `example.com` gives you `example.com` and `www.example.com`. The values here are only an example. Later, [`validateDestination`](destination-validation.md) looks at the host of the destination URL. If that host is not in the set, the request is rejected with a 422 error saying links may only point to marketplace pages. This is what stops the shortener from being used as an open redirect. The set is built once and never changes while the app runs. If `front_host` changes, you need to restart the service. The full check is described in [Check that a destination is a marketplace page](destination-validation.md).

**Look at:** [share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts)

## Pieces

- [Host check against the allowed set in validateDestination](destination-validation.md): Rejects any destination whose host is not in `allowedHosts` before the link is saved.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| other | `front_host config value` | Read once in the [`ShareLinkService`](link-click-analytics.md) constructor through [`ApiConfigService`](../../../../packages/backend/libs/common/config/api-config.service.ts#L44) to build the allowed hosts. |

## Watch out

- The set holds the `host`, not the hostname, so a port counts. A destination like `example.com:8080` will not match `example.com`.
- Only the front-end host and its `www.` version are allowed. Other subdomains, such as an API or a shop subdomain, are rejected.
- The set is built once in the constructor, so changing `front_host` needs a restart.
- If `front_host` is missing or not a valid URL, `new URL(...)` throws and the service fails to start.
